defects.description: Incorrect translation of the glossary term “brute force attacks”. The required Russian equivalent is “атаки методом грубой силы”, but the translation uses “атаки методом перебора”.
Nonsensical word inserted in the translation of the tip sentence, making the meaning unclear.
defects.quote: Список доступных настроек клетка см. в `ssh_config(5)`.
